entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The darkened plane after the Aurora, haunted by pucas, gwyllions, noggles, trows and hags.

entities.name: The Aurora
entities.description: A transformation that lessened kithkin kindness, deepened paranoia, robbed beings of their halves, and replaced changelings' innocence with malice.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: Paranoid kithkin who set traps for everything and live in douns under cenns.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: The kithkin mind-bond that carried Darial's last thoughts to his doun.

entities.name: Talara
entities.description: An elvish safewright who protects a woodland waterfall and prefers the screams of battle to the quiet after.

entities.name: Donal Alloway
entities.description: The cenn of Kinscaer.

entities.name: Kinscaer
entities.description: A kithkin doun.

entities.name: Olka
entities.description: A Mistmeadow witch.

entities.name: Awylla
entities.description: An elf whose salvaged dreams will be put to good use.

entities.name: Illulia of Nighthearth
entities.description: A cinder who watched her brothers' quenching and now leads the Nighthearth cult.

entities.name: Nighthearth
entities.description: A cult fascinated by torturing a people through the thoughtweft.

entities.name: Ashling, the Extinguisher
entities.description: A flamekin transformed by the Aurora into a relentless force of destruction; also called the Extinguisher.

entities.name: Darial
entities.description: A kithkin whose last thoughts were carried through the thoughtweft.

entities.name: Hob Heddil
entities.description: A speaker on soot imps.

entities.name: Gnarltrunk
entities.description: A treefolk whose knotholes multiplied.

entities.name: Frorn
entities.description: A creature kept by someone and unwilling to be thrown back.

entities.name: Gackt
entities.description: A person who regretted keeping pet toads on his head.

entities.name: Seyden
entities.description: A person transformed by a puca's magic.

entities.name: Dindun of Kulrath Mine
entities.description: A resident of Kulrath Mine.

entities.name: Mowagh the Gwyllion
entities.description: A gwyllion who studies how things fall apart.

entities.name: Boghald
entities.description: A Barrenton medic.

entities.name: Endry
entities.description: A faerie who tried to teach groundlings faerie tricks.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A treefolk whose sapling may bear fruit.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Queen of the faeries who grants favored subjects dreams.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: A land of unpredictable woods with glamer-polished trees.

entities.name: Kulrath Mine
entities.description: A mine location.

entities.name: Wilt-Leaf
entities.description: A forest torn up by a wurm.

entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: A region turned into a mudhole by a wurm.

entities.name: Dark Meanders
entities.description: A place of banishment for criminal merrows.

entities.name: Merrows
entities.description: Water folk who mark victims and banish criminals.

entities.name: Noggles
entities.description: Scavengers who believe they were the first race to walk Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Hobgoblins
entities.description: Farmers who sharpen implements excessively; one skewered faeries in Oona's skies.

entities.name: Duergars
entities.description: Underground workers with long memories.

entities.name: Gwyllions
entities.description: Hag-like spirits who unleash spirits from graveyards and set traps.

entities.name: The Seer's Parables
entities.description: An in-world text about divinities of Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Skulkin
entities.description: Bone constructs of many dire tales.

events.summary: The Aurora lessens kithkin kindness, deepens their paranoia and dulls their sense of pain.
events.quote: The Aurora had lessened the kithkins' kindness, deepened their paranoia, and dulled their sense of pain.

events.summary: The Aurora transforms Ashling into a relentless force of destruction.
events.quote: The Aurora had transformed her into a relentless force of destruction.

events.summary: Darial's last thoughts travel through the thoughtweft back to his doun.
events.quote: Their thoughtweft carried Darial's last thoughts back to his doun.

events.summary: Illulia watches her brothers' quenching and draws warmth from their dying rage.
events.quote: I was there to watch my brothers' quenching.

events.summary: A hobgoblin dragoon's lance ends faeries' mockery in Oona's skies.
events.quote: But his lance ended their mockery

events.summary: A wurm tears up the Wilt-Leaf, turns Mistmeadow into a mudhole and makes the river jump its banks.
events.quote: Last time, it tore up the Wilt-Leaf, turned Mistmeadow into a mudhole, and made the river jump its banks.

events.summary: Talara vows to send wave after wave of warriors against any who disturb a waterfall.
events.quote: She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.

events.summary: The Aurora replaces changelings' innocence with malice.
events.quote: The Aurora replaced the changelings' innocence with malice and their curiosity with hunger.
